title: CER-HV: A CER-Based Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Cleaning Datasets Applied to Arabic-Script HTR
reasoning: The paper focuses on Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) for Arabic-script languages and proposes a framework for data cleaning and noise detection. While it mentions 'cultural heritage' and that some datasets contain 'religious content' as a genre of text, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics. The core contribution is technical, related to improving dataset quality and model performance.
